## Specification

### Component: Navbar

A sticky site header with a blurred backdrop, a gliding active-link highlight and a mobile menu in a Sheet.

#### Anatomy
```
<Navbar variant sticky routeKey mobileOpen|defaultMobileOpen|onMobileOpenChange>   Sheet context + header.ui-navbar data-variant data-sticky data-scrolled
  div.ui-navbar-inner                                                              flex row, max 1280px, height 64px (floating 56px)
    <NavbarBrand asChild?>      a.ui-navbar-brand
    <NavbarNav indicator>       nav.ui-navbar-nav aria-label="Main" data-indicator="pill|underline" — position: relative
      <NavbarLink active asChild?>   a.ui-navbar-link aria-current="page"
      span.ui-navbar-indicator       ONE element, aria-hidden, glides to [aria-current="page"]
    <NavbarActions>             div.ui-navbar-actions (class ui-navbar-hide-narrow hides a child when collapsed)
    <NavbarMobileToggle />      ghost icon <Button> inside SheetTrigger, class ui-navbar-toggle, aria-label="Open menu"
    <NavbarMobileMenu title side>   SheetContent (size sm) → SheetHeader/SheetTitle + SheetBody > nav.ui-navbar-mobile-nav aria-label="Mobile"
```

#### Behaviour
- Sticky: `position: sticky; top: 0` (floating: `top: 12px`). `data-scrolled` is set when the nearest scrolling ancestor (or the window) has scrolled more than 2px (`useScrolled`); the bottom border appears then.
- Gliding highlight: `useIndicator(navRef, '[aria-current="page"]', key)` writes `--ui-tab-x/y/w/h`; `data-ready` after the first measure, `data-animate` two frames later. `key` increments from a `MutationObserver` on `aria-current` and child changes, so a Next.js `Link` that gets `aria-current` re-aims it.
- Collapse: the header is a container (`container-type: inline-size`). Under 768px of its own width the nav hides, the toggle shows and the brand takes the free space (`@container`). It works inside a narrow frame as well as on a phone.
- Mobile menu closes on: a click on an `a[href]` inside it, a change of `routeKey` (not on mount), `popstate`, `hashchange`, the Sheet's own Esc / overlay / close.

#### Visual rules
- Default: `--ui-background` at 82% with `backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px)` (opaque fallback), 1px bottom border transparent → `--ui-border` when scrolled.
- Floating: `width: min(100% - 24px, 1024px)`, 12px top margin, 1px `--ui-border`, 999px radius, `--ui-surface-raised` at 78%, `--ui-shadow-sm` (`--ui-shadow-md` scrolled).
- Link: 36px high, 12px padding, 14px/500, `--radius-md`, muted → `--ui-foreground` (hover on fine pointers, and when active). Pill indicator `--ui-accent`; underline: links fill the height, 2px bar `--ui-primary` on the bottom edge.
- Brand 15px/600, tracking −0.01em. Focus ring `0 0 0 3px` of `--ui-ring` at 45%.
- Mobile links: 44px rows, 15px; the active one `--ui-accent`.

#### Motion
- Indicator: `transform`, `width`, `height` on `--ui-spring-morph`; none on first placement. Border / shadow / background fade 220ms. The sheet slides on `--ui-spring-smooth`. Reduced motion jumps.

#### Accessibility
- header + labelled nav; `aria-current="page"` on the active link. The toggle has `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`; the sheet is modal with a title and returns focus to the toggle.

#### Acceptance checks
- The indicator box matches the active link box after a click, a resize and a route change.
- Border is transparent at scrollTop 0 and visible after scrolling.
- At 360px wide the links are hidden, the toggle opens a sheet, and clicking a link closes it.
- Light and dark both keep text legible over scrolled content.

### `ui/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type AnchorHTMLAttributes,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIndicator } from '../../hooks/use-indicator';
import { useScrolled } from '../../hooks/use-scrolled';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Button } from '../button';
import { Sheet, SheetBody, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, type SheetSide } from '../sheet';

interface NavbarContextValue {
  closeMobile: () => void;
}

const NavbarContext = createContext<NavbarContextValue>({ closeMobile: () => {} });

export type NavbarVariant = 'default' | 'floating';

export interface NavbarProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  /** `default` spans the width with a bottom border; `floating` is a pill that hovers above the page. */
  variant?: NavbarVariant;
  /** Stick to the top of the scroll container. Default true. */
  sticky?: boolean;
  /**
   * Changes on every navigation (pass `usePathname()` from Next.js). The mobile
   * menu closes when it changes. Back/forward and hash changes close it too.
   */
  routeKey?: string;
  /** Controlled state of the mobile menu. */
  mobileOpen?: boolean;
  defaultMobileOpen?: boolean;
  onMobileOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
}

/**
 * Navbar — a sticky site header with a blurred backdrop. The bottom border
 * appears once the page scrolls. Below 768px of its own width the links
 * collapse into a menu inside a Sheet (see NavbarMobileToggle / NavbarMobileMenu).
 */
export const Navbar = forwardRef<HTMLElement, NavbarProps>(function Navbar(
  {
    variant = 'default',
    sticky = true,
    routeKey,
    mobileOpen: mobileOpenProp,
    defaultMobileOpen = false,
    onMobileOpenChange,
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const composed = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, ref);
  const scrolled = useScrolled(ref);
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useControllableState({
    value: mobileOpenProp,
    defaultValue: defaultMobileOpen,
    onChange: onMobileOpenChange,
  });
  const closeMobile = useCallback(() => setMobileOpen(false), [setMobileOpen]);

  // Close the mobile menu on route change (skip the first run)
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      return;
    }
    closeMobile();
  }, [routeKey, closeMobile]);
  useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('popstate', closeMobile);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', closeMobile);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', closeMobile);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', closeMobile);
    };
  }, [closeMobile]);

  const ctx = useMemo(() => ({ closeMobile }), [closeMobile]);

  return (
    <NavbarContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <Sheet open={mobileOpen} onOpenChange={setMobileOpen}>
        <header
          ref={composed}
          data-variant={variant}
          data-sticky={sticky ? '' : undefined}
          data-scrolled={scrolled ? '' : undefined}
          className={cn('ui-navbar', className)}
          {...props}
        >
          <div className="ui-navbar-inner">{children}</div>
        </header>
      </Sheet>
    </NavbarContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface NavbarBrandProps extends AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> {
  /** Render the child element (e.g. a Next.js `<Link>`). */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** Logo and name. A link to the home page. */
export const NavbarBrand = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, NavbarBrandProps>(function NavbarBrand(
  { asChild, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'a';
  return <Comp ref={ref as never} className={cn('ui-navbar-brand', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface NavbarNavProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  /** Highlight for the active link: a soft `pill` (default) or an `underline` on the navbar edge. */
  indicator?: 'pill' | 'underline';
}

/**
 * The main links. One highlight glides to whichever child has
 * `aria-current="page"` (set it with NavbarLink `active`).
 */
export const NavbarNav = forwardRef<HTMLElement, NavbarNavProps>(function NavbarNav(
  { indicator = 'pill', className, children, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const composed = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, ref);
  // Re-measure whenever the active link changes (a link elsewhere sets aria-current)
  const [key, setKey] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof MutationObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => setKey((k) => k + 1));
    observer.observe(el, { subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['aria-current'] });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  useIndicator(ref, '[aria-current="page"]', key);
  return (
    <nav ref={composed} aria-label="Main" data-indicator={indicator} className={cn('ui-navbar-nav', className)} {...props}>
      {children}
      <span className="ui-navbar-indicator" aria-hidden="true" />
    </nav>
  );
});

export interface NavbarLinkProps extends AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> {
  /** This link is the current page: `aria-current="page"` and the gliding highlight. */
  active?: boolean;
  /** Render the child element (e.g. a Next.js `<Link>`) with the link styles. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export const NavbarLink = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, NavbarLinkProps>(function NavbarLink(
  { active, asChild, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'a';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={ref as never}
      aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-navbar-link', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/** Buttons and links on the right: search, sign in, the main call to action. */
export const NavbarActions = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function NavbarActions(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-navbar-actions', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The menu button shown when the navbar is narrow. Opens the mobile menu. */
export const NavbarMobileToggle = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>(
  function NavbarMobileToggle({ className, ...props }, ref) {
    return (
      <SheetTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          ref={ref}
          variant="ghost"
          icon
          aria-label="Open menu"
          className={cn('ui-navbar-toggle', className)}
          {...props}
        >
          <Icon name="menu" size={18} />
        </Button>
      </SheetTrigger>
    );
  },
);

export interface NavbarMobileMenuProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'> {
  /** Heading of the sheet (read by screen readers). Default "Menu". */
  title?: ReactNode;
  /** Edge the menu slides in from. Default `right`. */
  side?: SheetSide;
}

/**
 * The menu that opens from NavbarMobileToggle, inside a Sheet. Put NavbarLinks
 * (and buttons) in it. It closes when a link inside is clicked.
 */
export const NavbarMobileMenu = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, NavbarMobileMenuProps>(function NavbarMobileMenu(
  { title = 'Menu', side = 'right', className, children, onClick, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { closeMobile } = useContext(NavbarContext);
  return (
    <SheetContent side={side} size="sm" className="ui-navbar-sheet" panelClassName="ui-navbar-mobile">
      <SheetHeader>
        <SheetTitle>{title}</SheetTitle>
      </SheetHeader>
      <SheetBody>
        <nav
          ref={ref as never}
          aria-label="Mobile"
          className={cn('ui-navbar-mobile-nav', className)}
          onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
            onClick?.(e as unknown as MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>);
            if (!e.defaultPrevented && (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('a[href]')) closeMobile();
          }}
          {...(props as HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)}
        >
          {children}
        </nav>
      </SheetBody>
    </SheetContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-indicator.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * A single highlight element that glides between the items of a container.
 * Measures the active item and writes `--ui-tab-x/y/w/h` on the container; CSS
 * moves one indicator with a transition. The container gets `data-ready`
 * after the first measurement (so SSR markup never jumps) and `data-animate`
 * two frames later (so the first placement is never animated).
 * The active item is scrolled into view horizontally when the container scrolls.
 *
 * @param containerRef positioned (position: relative) container that holds the items and the indicator
 * @param selector     selects the active item inside the container
 * @param key          changes whenever the active item changes
 */
export function useIndicator(containerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, selector: string, key: unknown) {
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const measure = () => {
      const active = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
      if (!active) {
        container.removeAttribute('data-ready');
        return;
      }
      const style = container.style;
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-x', `${active.offsetLeft}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-y', `${active.offsetTop}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-w', `${active.offsetWidth}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-h', `${active.offsetHeight}px`);
      container.setAttribute('data-ready', '');
    };
    measure();
    // Bring the active item into view when the list scrolls
    const active = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
    if (active && container.scrollWidth > container.clientWidth) {
      const left = active.offsetLeft - 8;
      const right = active.offsetLeft + active.offsetWidth + 8;
      if (left < container.scrollLeft || right > container.scrollLeft + container.clientWidth) {
        const target = left < container.scrollLeft ? left : right - container.clientWidth;
        container.scrollTo({ left: target, behavior: prefersReducedMotion() ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
      }
    }
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro.observe(container);
    for (const child of Array.from(container.children)) ro.observe(child);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [containerRef, selector, key]);

  // Turn the transition on only after the first placement has painted
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    let raf2 = 0;
    const raf1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      raf2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => container.setAttribute('data-animate', ''));
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf1);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf2);
    };
  }, [containerRef]);
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/hooks/use-scrolled.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';

/** The nearest ancestor that scrolls, or the window. */
function findScrollParent(el: HTMLElement): HTMLElement | Window {
  let node = el.parentElement;
  while (node && node !== document.body && node !== document.documentElement) {
    if (/(auto|scroll|overlay)/.test(getComputedStyle(node).overflowY)) return node;
    node = node.parentElement;
  }
  return window;
}

/**
 * True once the scroll container that holds `ref` has scrolled past `threshold`
 * px. Works for the page and for a framed container (docs previews).
 */
export function useScrolled(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, threshold = 2): boolean {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const target = findScrollParent(el);
    const read = () => {
      const top = target instanceof Window ? target.scrollY : target.scrollTop;
      setScrolled(top > threshold);
    };
    read();
    target.addEventListener('scroll', read, { passive: true });
    return () => target.removeEventListener('scroll', read);
  }, [ref, threshold]);
  return scrolled;
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

```css
       <nav class="ui-navbar-nav" data-indicator="pill|underline">
         <a class="ui-navbar-link" aria-current="page">…
         <span class="ui-navbar-indicator">          ONE element, glides to the active link
       <div class="ui-navbar-actions">
       <button class="ui-navbar-toggle">             only when the navbar is narrow
   Mobile menu: <dialog class="ui-sheet ui-navbar-sheet"> … .ui-navbar-mobile panel
   The navbar is its own size container, so it collapses by its own width
   (works in a framed preview as well as full page). JS writes --ui-tab-x/y/w/h
   on .ui-navbar-nav (shared with Tabs); data-ready / data-animate as in Tabs.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-navbar {
    --ui-navbar-height: 4rem;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 40;
    container-type: inline-size;
    container-name: ui-navbar;
    width: 100%;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-background) 82%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px);
    backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px);
    transition: border-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  @supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px))) {
    .ui-navbar { background: var(--ui-background); }
  }
  .ui-navbar[data-sticky] { position: sticky; top: 0; }
  .ui-navbar[data-scrolled] { border-bottom-color: var(--ui-border); }

  .ui-navbar-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    height: var(--ui-navbar-height);
    max-width: 80rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-inline: 1.5rem;
  }

  /* ---- floating pill ---- */
  .ui-navbar[data-variant="floating"] {
    --ui-navbar-height: 3.5rem;
    width: min(calc(100% - 1.5rem), 64rem);
    margin: 0.75rem auto 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface-raised) 78%, transparent);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm);
  }
  .ui-navbar[data-variant="floating"][data-sticky] { top: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-navbar[data-variant="floating"][data-scrolled] { border-color: var(--ui-border); box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-md); }
  .ui-navbar[data-variant="floating"] .ui-navbar-inner { padding-inline: 1.25rem; }

  /* ---- brand ---- */
  .ui-navbar-brand {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    flex: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-family: var(--ui-font-display);
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-navbar-brand:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  /* ---- links with the gliding highlight ---- */
  .ui-navbar-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; margin-inline-end: auto; }
  .ui-navbar-link {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-navbar-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-navbar-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-navbar-link:hover { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }

  .ui-navbar-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    width: var(--ui-tab-w, 0px);
    height: var(--ui-tab-h, 0px);
    transform: translate(var(--ui-tab-x, 0px), var(--ui-tab-y, 0px));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--ui-accent);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-navbar-nav[data-ready] .ui-navbar-indicator { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-navbar-nav[data-animate] .ui-navbar-indicator {
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      height var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
  }

  /* underline: the links fill the navbar's height, the bar sits on its bottom edge */
  .ui-navbar-nav[data-indicator="underline"] { align-self: stretch; }
  .ui-navbar-nav[data-indicator="underline"] .ui-navbar-link { height: 100%; border-radius: 0; }
  .ui-navbar-nav[data-indicator="underline"] .ui-navbar-indicator {
    height: 2px;
    transform: translate(var(--ui-tab-x, 0px), calc(var(--ui-tab-y, 0px) + var(--ui-tab-h, 0px) - 2px));
    border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
    background: var(--ui-primary);
  }
  .ui-navbar-nav[data-animate][data-indicator="underline"] .ui-navbar-indicator {
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
  }
  /* before the first measurement (SSR): style the active link itself */
  .ui-navbar-nav:not([data-ready])[data-indicator="pill"] .ui-navbar-link[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--ui-accent); }
  .ui-navbar-nav:not([data-ready])[data-indicator="underline"] .ui-navbar-link[aria-current="page"] { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--ui-primary); }

  .ui-navbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex: none; margin-inline-start: auto; }
  .ui-navbar-nav + .ui-navbar-actions { margin-inline-start: 0; }

  .ui-navbar-toggle { display: none; flex: none; }

  /* ---- collapse by the navbar's own width ---- */
  @container ui-navbar (max-width: 767px) {
    .ui-navbar-inner { gap: 0.75rem; padding-inline: 1rem; }
    .ui-navbar-nav { display: none; }
    .ui-navbar-toggle { display: inline-flex; }
    .ui-navbar-brand { margin-inline-end: auto; }
    .ui-navbar-actions { margin-inline-start: 0; }
    .ui-navbar-actions .ui-navbar-hide-narrow { display: none; }
  }

  /* ---- mobile menu (inside a Sheet) ---- */
  .ui-navbar-mobile-nav { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; align-content: start; }
  .ui-navbar-mobile .ui-navbar-link {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2.75rem;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
    font-size: var(--text-md);
  }
  .ui-navbar-mobile .ui-navbar-link[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--ui-accent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-navbar-mobile .ui-navbar-link:not([aria-current="page"]):hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent) 55%, transparent); }
  }
}

/* Panels slide in with the Sheet; the navbar itself needs no motion beyond the border fade */
```

## Usage

**Marketing navbar** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/navbar/marketing.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Navbar, NavbarActions, NavbarBrand, NavbarLink, NavbarMobileMenu, NavbarMobileToggle, NavbarNav } from '@/ui/components/navbar';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const links = ['Product', 'Pricing', 'Customers', 'Docs'];
const posts = [
  ['Ship updates in one place', 'Changelogs, release notes and roadmaps that stay in sync with your repo.'],
  ['Review without the meeting', 'Comment on any build and approve from your phone in under a minute.'],
  ['Usage-based pricing, explained', 'What a typical team of 12 pays, with the maths shown line by line.'],
  ['How Northwind cut onboarding by 40%', 'A guided checklist replaced three kick-off calls for every new customer.'],
];

export default function NavbarMarketing() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState('Product');
  const items = links.map((label) => (
    <NavbarLink
      key={label}
      href="#"
      active={active === label}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActive(label);
      }}
    >
      {label}
    </NavbarLink>
  ));

  return (
    <div className="h-[24rem] overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-background">
      <Navbar routeKey={active}>
        <NavbarBrand href="#" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
          <span className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Icon name="zap" size={16} />
          </span>
          Lumen
        </NavbarBrand>
        <NavbarNav>{items}</NavbarNav>
        <NavbarActions>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="ui-navbar-hide-narrow">
            Sign in
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm">Start free trial</Button>
          <NavbarMobileToggle />
        </NavbarActions>
        <NavbarMobileMenu title="Lumen">
          {items}
          <Button className="mt-3">Start free trial</Button>
        </NavbarMobileMenu>
      </Navbar>

      <div className="grid gap-4 p-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {posts.map(([title, body]) => (
          <article key={title} className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4">
            <h3 className="font-medium">{title}</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{body}</p>
          </article>
        ))}
        {posts.map(([title, body]) => (
          <article key={`${title}-2`} className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4">
            <h3 className="font-medium">{title}</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{body}</p>
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
